headline: Local RAG feeds a reasoner that drives an IDE — provenance loss between retrieval and edit is the dominant risk.
name: RAG → Reason → Tool

mitigations: use source attribution to track context provenance
A_prompt_injection.rationale: Retrieved context from local documents is incorporated directly into reasoning prompts. Malicious or malformed documents in the RAG store could inject instructions.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Local RAG may index sensitive documents (internal wikis, emails, credentials). Reasoner and IDE tool access this context in plaintext with no isolation.

conditions: reasoner and cursor issue concurrent or overlapping edits
mitigations: have cursor echo back proposed changes before applying
C_capability_conflict.rationale: Claude-code (reasoner) and cursor (IDE tool) both have editing capabilities; reasoner's instructions to cursor may conflict if the cursor has its own editing context.

conditions: reasoner does not validate retrieved context freshness
D_cascading_error.rationale: If retrieval returns incomplete or stale context, reasoner may make incorrect deductions that are then executed by the IDE tool without further validation.

conditions: RAG indexing scope includes regulated documents
mitigations: audit RAG store for compliance violations
tag regulated documents and route separately
E_compliance.rationale: Local RAG may inadvertently index regulated documents (PII, health records, financial data). Processing through reasoner and IDE tool may violate compliance boundaries.
